description: Inspect the secret-free effective GitHub account, credential health, Git author, and scopes for this agent. Read-only: reports what `gh auth status` and the connector credential chain say, plus whether the credential actually answers the GitHub API. If the credential is not healthy, ask the operator to run `gh auth login` (or set GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN), then check github_identity_status again.
name: github_identity_status
